case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparent overview of your cost drivers. We value the long-standing cooperation and want to renew the frame agreement on a solid basis.

Our own data shows a different picture:

Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

Against this background, we have prepared three structured options. Each offers a longer contract term, which gives you planning security, and the options with longer payment terms are priced accordingly:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 414.58; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 415.97; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

The options are laid out so they can go straight to your pricing committee. If it needs further documents or details from us, we will gladly provide them.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your records regarding past pricing and delivery performance, which we acknowledge. As to the delivery record and price history data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. We are prepared to build on your Option A, accepting the 24-month contract term and the 45-day payment period. In exchange for this extended commitment, we can reduce our price to EUR 429.58 per unit. 

Our revised Angebot stands at a price of €431.77 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €429.58 per unit, under an alternative option offering a price of €429.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for acknowledging our price and delivery data. We also understand that price changes need to pass through your pricing committee, and we have kept that in mind.

We have therefore set out three clear options, each building on the longer contract term you proposed and differing in payment period. Longer payment terms are reflected in the price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 421.26; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.56; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Each option is a firm proposal that can go straight to your committee. If it helps, we can provide any supporting information your approval needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
